ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) base comprising approximately 85% of the visible surface area, punctuated by localized high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations; three distinct deep notches are visible on the left lobe's posterior boundary, while the right lobe exhibits higher frequency, lower amplitude jagged variations.
